title: Validate a browser ONNX port of Inflect Micro v2

details: Create an isolated `inflect-browser-port/` workspace and execute the complete feasibility process specified in HANDOFF.md. Inspect the tagged `owensong/Inflect-Micro-v2` package, reproduce deterministic Python baselines, export only validated ONNX graph(s), reproduce/validate the English frontend in the browser, and run the output in actual Chromium or Electron with ONNX Runtime Web/WASM. Preserve licenses/notices and exclude heavyweight artifacts from source control. Publish `REPORT.md`, reproducible conversion/harness scripts, prompt corpus, and a one-command verification script. Do not modify this Obsidian plugin, do not use `onnxruntime-node` as the proof, do not add a Python sidecar, and do not substitute models. Verification gate: run `npm run verify-browser-port` from the new workspace with assets cached locally; expected output reports frontend-parity, ONNX-checker, Chromium/Electron ORT-Web synthesis, WAV validation, and a GO/NO-GO summary. STOP conditions: any unsupported ORT Web operation without a practical rewrite, unreproducible/licensing-blocked frontend, renderer-only failure, unacceptable memory/performance/quality, or unavailable lawful source artifacts must result in a documented NO-GO rather than plugin work.
